if: the discount is given AFTER the supply has been effected
it is established in terms of an agreement entered into at or before the time of the supply
it is specifically linked to relevant invoices
the input tax credit attributable to the discount has been REVERSED by the recipient, on the basis of a document issued by the supplier
then: the discount is EXCLUDED from the value of supply
note: All four conditions, and the last one is not in the supplier's control — the exclusion depends on an act by the RECIPIENT. A post-supply discount that fails any limb leaves the value unchanged, so the credit note does not reduce the GST. This is the clause where a wrong entry is most likely: the discount is visible, the recipient's ITC reversal is not.
